summary: Senior Data Scientist & ML Engineer focused on transforming data into products that have real impacts, especially in business process agility gains. I work from planning and designing solutions for projects to developing products in data science and machine learning engineering, as well as mentoring professionals in this area.

summaryBullets.label: Ambev Tech
summaryBullets.text: I delivered intelligent agents for the Legal department using Python, LLMs (GPT-4o/GPT-4o-mini), and OCR with Tesseract, integrated into the internal Asimov Foundation framework on Azure, orchestrated via Azure Service Bus, and exposed as versioned REST APIs with observability, CI/CD, and data governance (PostgreSQL and Azure Blob Storage).

summaryBullets.label: State Government - GovTech
summaryBullets.text: I acted as Solution Architect for GovTech projects across SEGER, SESA, SEDU, SEJUS, SESP, SECONT, Civil Police (ES), SEPOL and DETRAN (RJ). I architected complete Data Lakehouses with Cloudera Data Platform (HDFS/Impala/Ranger/Kerberos) + PySpark + Airflow, ETL pipelines across all layers (Bronze, Silver, Gold), AI models for anomaly detection, document classification, NER and forecasting, plus RAG-based AI agents and 50+ data products.

summaryBullets.label: Eletrobrás Group
summaryBullets.text: I designed and developed an integrated legal Data Mart in SAS Viya with analytical dashboards for legal intelligence. I built predictive models for projecting legal process volume, closure detection via NLP and content-based textual classification, with a hybrid SAS Compute + PySpark architecture.

summaryBullets.label: Court of Accounts
summaryBullets.text: I developed crawlers for automated collection of official gazettes, NLP models with NER for entity extraction in bidding notices and contracts, structured data in PostgreSQL and fed SAS Visual Investigator as an investigative platform for auditors.

summaryBullets.label: Oil & Gas | Petrobras & Constellation
summaryBullets.text: I developed a high-fidelity Digital Twin simulator for Blowout Preventer equipment using Matlab/Simulink, built the 'BOP Data Universe' BI environment, implemented text mining in failure records and created a preventive alert system based on CBM (Condition-Based Maintenance) with clustering and predictive models for IoT/sensor analysis.

stack: SAS Viya, Cloudera Data Platform (HDFS, Impala, Spark, Ranger, Kerberos), PySpark, Airflow, MLflow, FastAPI, Docker/Kubernetes (Rancher and OpenShift), AWS, Azure, PostgreSQL, Python (Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Numpy), Node/React, SLM/LLM/GenAI, Computer Vision, NLP (spaCy, NLTK, Embeddings, Vectors Database, Transformers), OCR (Tesseract), Power BI, SAS Visual Analytics.
